summary.text: Tracy Marra was first elected in 2022 to represent Connecticut's 141st House District, serving Norwalk and Darien.

paragraphs.text: For the 2025-2026 session she is Ranking Member of the Energy and Technology Committee and also serves on the Public Health and Transportation committees.
Born and raised in Lexington, Kentucky, she earned a Doctor of Pharmacy degree from Butler University in 1999 and worked as a pharmacist.
